title: Noun gender
explanation:
Every Spanish noun is masculine or feminine. The ending is a hint, not a rule: libro ends in -o and is masculine, casa ends in -a and is feminine. Día and mapa end in -a and are masculine. Mano ends in -o and is feminine.

The article is the signal to trust. El and un go with a masculine singular noun. La and una go with a feminine singular noun.
commonMistake: Choosing the article from the English word, or treating agua as masculine. Agua is feminine. The singular uses el because la agua is hard to say.
